name: A failed turn puts Pixel out, held
case: The agent's turn fails after a couple of minutes on a rate limit. Pixel is put out and shows it for a while: an annoyed, irritated, grumpy, disappointed or sad face played as a failure, held twice or more. Its mood turns annoyed.
why: characters/pixel/steering/personality/pixel.md: a turn fails, an annoyed face held twice for a small one; characters/pixel/steering/mood/calm.md: leaves for annoyed at a failure
